description: Get available free slots for a specific CRM calendar within a date range.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

endDate.description: End date for slot lookup (epoch ms or ISO string)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

startDate.description: Start date for slot lookup (epoch ms or ISO string)

userId.description: Filter slots by specific user / team member ID

name: crm_get_free_slots
